products.short_description: Hunt, simulate, and auto-respond to email threats — the Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 detection and response features beyond spam filtering.
products.description:
Hunt, simulate, and auto-respond to email threats — the Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 detection and response features beyond spam filtering.

Blocking spam is table stakes; the real value of Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 is what happens after delivery — hunting live threats, training users against real phishing, and auto-remediating. This solution stands up Threat Explorer/Real-time detections, Attack Simulation Training, and Automated Investigation & Response (AIR), plus email-focused Advanced Hunting.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Threat Explorer / Real-time detections for post-delivery email threat hunting
  • Attack Simulation Training campaigns and user risk reporting
  • Automated Investigation & Response (AIR) playbooks and approvals
  • Email Advanced Hunting queries and custom detections
  • Remediation actions (soft/hard delete, ZAP) with approval gates

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A Defender for Office 365 that detects, trains, and auto-remediates post-delivery — not just a spam filter you already had.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • DEFMDOP2-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 readiness for post-delivery detect/hunt/simulate/respond (read-only)
    • DEFMDOP2-Hunt.ps1 — run the email Advanced Hunting KQL library against Defender for Office 365 (read-only)
    • DEFMDOP2-Remediate.ps1 — PREVIEW an approval-gated email remediation batch (soft/hard delete, ZAP-style). Preview-first
    • DEFMDOP2-Report.ps1 — report post-delivery email threats and Attack Simulation user-risk (read-only)
    • DEFMDOP2-Validate.ps1 — run the 05-testing pass/fail gates for the Plan 2 detect/respond build (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
